description: This file defines the ConsistencyTestGrain class, which is an Orleans grain used for testing consistency in transactional scenarios. It includes methods for running recursive transaction operations, reading and writing state, and logging activities.

classes.name: ConsistencyTestGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain class used for testing transactional consistency, capable of performing recursive read/write operations with logging and concurrency control.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Serializable class representing the grain's persistent state, including the last writer transaction and sequence number.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes a transactional operation, possibly recursively, with options for read/write behavior, and logs activities.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Performs a read operation on the grain's state, returning an array of observations.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Performs a write operation on the grain's state, updating transaction info and sequence number.

methods.name: Recurse
methods.description: Performs recursive transactional calls, either sequentially or in parallel, with stopping conditions based on time and depth.
